text: Accepted visibleMessagePaneBrowser returns the inner getMessagePaneBrowser for a single message, the summary browser for multi-selection and the web browser for a web page. Find commands route to the appropriate browser/findbar, and displaying a new view hides competing findbars. Keep the inner single-message browser distinction when implementing zoom or search; the outer about:message browser is not the content target. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: MessagePane zoom and find route through the visible browser’s own contract
